title: Law to limit NYPD holds for immigration detainers
summary: This bill would restrict when the NYPD can hold someone in custody solely because of a federal civil immigration detainer. Police could only detain a person beyond their normal release time if federal agents present a judicial warrant and a database check shows the person has a violent or serious conviction or is a possible match in the terrorist screening database. The bill removes a prior provision allowing up to 48 extra hours of detention without a judicial warrant in certain cases.
